title: One recording chunk, unpacked
description: The body of POST /v1/parts/{recording}?key=&t=&doc=&seq= is the gzip of this: a JSON array of rrweb 2.1.7 events, in the order they happened. The service reads only each event's type and timestamp, Meta events (4: the page's size) and Custom events (5) with a tag it knows; everything else is stored and replayed as sent. Text must already be masked when the token says mask: true - the service scans for leaks and refuses the chunk, it never repairs one.

type.description: rrweb EventType: 0 DomContentLoaded, 1 Load, 2 FullSnapshot, 3 IncrementalSnapshot, 4 Meta, 5 Custom, 6 Plugin.

tag.description: The marks the service and the player read: env {path, w, h, lang, translated?, rotated?} (a document starts), page {name, url} (the host's page changed), press {label, tag} (a control was pressed), dialog {open, title}, refused {fields: [names], first?} (a form was refused), error {name, message} (an error in the browser), visit {phase: start|finish, method, url} (a request the page sent), broken {kind} (the server answered with an error), hidden / visible (the tab was left / came back), pagehide (the page is going). Others are kept and shown as they are.
